answer: A gale of fakes is stopped by a stake-weighted work auction: each epoch only 100 paid slots are auctioned and an identity must bid a refundable 5 POA stake to enter. The bid floor doubles per extra bid from the same wallet cluster, so the 10th fake stakes 2,560 POA while one honest agent stakes 5. A plume of bids from one operator is priced out; a timber-strong honest agent keeps its stake by doing the work.
